s1_netrev: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) as total_net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_netrev_p2: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) as net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_netrev_p3: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) as certified_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_aov: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as aov FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_aov_p2: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as avg_order_value FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_aov_p3: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as typical_order_value FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_margin: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate) - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) as total_gross_margin FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_active_cust: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_key) as active_customers FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_active_p2: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_key) as distinct_customers FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_active_p3: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_key) as customers_with_shipment FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_gross_rev: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) as gross_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_orders: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as order_count FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_top_customer: SELECT o.customer_key, c.full_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) as total_spent FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_key = c.customer_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) GROUP BY o.customer_key, c.full_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1
s2_shipping_total: SELECT SUM(o.shipping_fee) as total_shipping_fees FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s2_shipping_region: SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(o.shipping_fee) as total_shipping_fees FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) GROUP BY o.ship_region ORDER BY o.ship_region
s2_rev_and_ship: SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) as net_revenue, (SELECT SUM(o2.shipping_fee) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.ship_region = o.ship_region AND o2.status IN (3, 4)) as total_shipping_fees FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) GROUP BY o.ship_region ORDER BY o.ship_region
s2_lines: SELECT COUNT(*) as line_count FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s2_ship_pct: SELECT (SUM(o.shipping_fee) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) * 100) as shipping_pct_of_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s2_avg_line_disc: SELECT SUM(o.shipping_fee) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as avg_shipping_per_order FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s3_refund_total: SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) as total_refunds FROM returns r
s3_refund_by_cat: SELECT p.category, SUM(r.refund_amount) as total_refunds FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id AND r.line_number = oi.line_number JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category
s3_refund_units: SELECT SUM(r.return_qty) as total_units_returned FROM returns r
s3_net_of_refunds: SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)) - (SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) FROM returns r) as net_revenue_minus_refunds
s3_refund_rev_by_cat: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) as net_revenue, (SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi2 ON r.order_id = oi2.order_id AND r.line_number = oi2.line_number JOIN products p2 ON oi2.product_key = p2.product_key WHERE p2.category = p.category) as total_refunds FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category
s5_ship_pct_region: SELECT o.ship_region, (SUM(o.shipping_fee) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) * 100) as shipping_pct_of_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) GROUP BY o.ship_region ORDER BY o.ship_region
s7_vocab_paidsearch: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) as net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) AND o.channel IN ('paid_search', 'Paid-Search', 'PPC')
s7_vocab_paidsearch_orders: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as order_count FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) AND o.channel IN ('paid_search', 'Paid-Search', 'PPC')
s7_ambiguous_sales: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as sales FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s7_ambiguous_best: SELECT p.product_name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) GROUP BY p.product_key, p.product_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) DESC LIMIT 1
s8_rev_2024: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) as net_revenue_2024 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts) = 2024
s8_rev_fy2024: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) as net_revenue_fy2024 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) AND date_trunc('year', o.order_ts + INTERVAL 11 MONTH) = '2024-01-01'
s8_rev_by_month: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) as order_month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) as net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts) = 2024 GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) ORDER BY order_month
s8_rev_2023: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) as net_revenue_2023 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts) = 2023
